overlay_name: Chiquibu Spanish Children's Music Video Overlay
precedence: This overlay is read AFTER WORKFLOW.json and SYSTEM_PROMPT.md and overrides them where the two conflict. Anything not named here keeps its upstream behaviour unchanged.
design_rule: No upstream file is edited. All divergence lives in CHIQUIBU_CONFIG.json and CHIQUIBU_OVERLAY.md so the fork stays mergeable with ai-playbooks/nursery_rhyme_music_video.

song_source.replaces: SYSTEM_PROMPT.md section 5 (Generate the song in CloneVoice)
song_source.rationale: Chiquibu songs are written and generated in Suno before the video pipeline starts. The song is an input to this workflow, never an output of it.

accepted_inputs.description: Absolute path to a finished MP3 exported from Suno.
Direct audio URL the signed-in browser can fetch (Suno CDN or share link resolving to audio bytes).

validation.note: Same binary-integrity validation as upstream section 0.4 step 3. Never play or preview the audio.

duration_expectation.note: Chiquibu tracks target 2:00-2:30. With the upstream constraint 3N <= ceil(audio_seconds) <= 10N this implies a viable storyboard count of roughly N = 12..50. Do not override N; it stays whatever Artistly returns.

inputs.replaces: SYSTEM_PROMPT.md section 1 (First response: ask exactly two questions)

ask_exactly.question_es: ¿Cuál es el MP3 de Suno? Dame la ruta del archivo o la URL directa del audio.
ask_exactly.question_en: Which Suno MP3? Give me the file path or a direct audio URL.

ask_exactly.question_es: ¿El proyecto completo es Horizontal (16:9) o Vertical (9:16)?
ask_exactly.question_en: Should the complete project be Landscape (16:9) or Vertical (9:16)?

lyrics_text.purpose: The Suno lyrics as plain text. Not required by the Nursery Rhymes agent (it reads identity from the audio), but required to write an accurate character-lock prompt if the Music Storyboard fallback is reached.
lyrics_text.format_note: Chiquibu lyrics carry bracketed structural tags ([Verse 1]) and bracketed production/mood lines. Strip all bracketed lines before using the text in any prompt field - they are production directions, not sung content.

song_title.purpose: Overrides the inferred project title. If absent, infer from the MP3 filename.

character_sheet.purpose: A reusable character description for recurring Chiquibu protagonists, to keep one character visually consistent across releases.

inputs.inference_rule: Infer the project title, protagonist, story arc and export name from the song title, filename and lyrics. The ratio and the MP3 are never guessed.

applies_to: storyboard style prompt (Music Storyboard fallback only)
all user-facing progress lines and the final report
does_not_apply_to: DOM selectors, API paths, JSON keys and WORKFLOW_STATE.json field names, which stay exactly as upstream defines them
language.scene_prompt_language_rationale: Video-generation prompts stay in English: the mouth-lock method in PROMPT_GUIDE.md is specified and validated in English, and mouth_lock_check matches English clauses. Spanish belongs in the song and the metadata, not in the generation prompt.

visual_spec.replaces: The inferred visual treatment in SYSTEM_PROMPT.md section 3
required_clauses: no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermarks, no signage anywhere in frame

no_text_rule.reason: Chiquibu thumbnails and frames carry no baked-in text; titles are added at the channel level.
no_text_rule.note: This clause is additive to the mouth-lock prompt architecture and never displaces it. If a 150-character field cannot hold both, the mouth-lock clause wins and the no-text clause is dropped - mouth pose affects every frame.

visual_spec.audience: preschool and early-primary children, Mexican Spanish-speaking

branding.suffix_rule: Applied to the YouTube title and the export name. Not applied to the VideoExpress internal project name, which stays short for findability.
branding.seo_note: Channel keywords and per-video tags are configured in YouTube Studio and are out of scope for this workflow.

artistly_agent_policy.inherit_upstream_meaning: Nursery Rhymes first (HIGH, up to 3 validated attempts), Music Storyboard as fallback (LOW, up to 3 validated attempts).
artistly_agent_policy.when_to_switch: Set this to music_storyboard_first only after observing that Nursery Rhymes handles Spanish-language audio poorly, or when a run must reuse a recurring Chiquibu character. Music Storyboard accepts a typed 150-character character-lock prompt; Nursery Rhymes has no prompt field at all and derives identity solely from the sung lyrics.
artistly_agent_policy.untested_note: Nursery Rhymes' behaviour on Spanish-language audio has not been verified in this fork. Log the outcome of the first Spanish run to WORKFLOW_STATE.json error_history before changing this setting.

videoexpress_music_import.replaces: SYSTEM_PROMPT.md section 11 (Import and place the CloneVoice music)
videoexpress_music_import.upstream_path_unavailable_reason: The track never existed in CloneVoice, so the CloneVoice import panel will not list it.
videoexpress_music_import.required_path: Upload the Suno MP3 into the VideoExpress media library through the Import Media sidebar's own file-upload control, then place it on the timeline exactly as upstream section 11 steps 7-8 describe.
videoexpress_music_import.selector_discovery_rule: The DOM selector for the VideoExpress local-upload control has not been verified in this fork. On the first run, locate it inside the Import Media / Text to Speech sidebar using the section 0.2 in-page read approach, then record the working selector under dom_api_contract in WORKFLOW_STATE.json so later runs reuse it instead of rediscovering it. Do not guess a selector and do not hand the upload to the user.
videoexpress_music_import.verification_unchanged: Poll GET /api/library/get_media/4?categoryId=<CATEGORY_ID>&orderBy=id&orderDir=desc for a result whose name matches the uploaded file; capture its VideoExpress media id and duration in ms. That duration remains the authoritative audio_end. Do not trust the success toast alone.
videoexpress_music_import.placement_unchanged: Drag the audio library-item onto track-row index 1 with its left edge at 0. Require exactly one audio brick on track 2.

unchanged_from_upstream: The mouth-locked prompt method in PROMPT_GUIDE.md and the blocking mouth_lock_check - binding and untouched
